snippet.title: Starforged Legacy | Launch Date Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Outlast the onslaught in a sci-fi survivors-like where your decisions matter as much as your firepower. Command customizable starships, enhance your arsenal with 100+ strategy-defining upgrades, and annihilate endless fleets of cosmic combatants! Carve your legacy among the stars and die trying!

Starforged Legacy blasts into Early Access on April 16th, 2026!

Play the demo on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3353390?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=launchdatetrailer
